entry.text: In a report dated May 13, 2022, a panel of 18 people recommended that the book remain in Polk County Public Schools' libraries, after a conservative group complained that it was among 16 books that "contained pornography" or were "harmful to children". The panel was split on the grade level at which it should be available.

sources.title: Polk County book review panel votes to return 'More Happy Than Not' to school library shelves (The Ledger)
sources.quote: Fri, May 13, 2022 at 9:01 AM UTC 12 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. LAKELAND — A panel of 18 people recommended that Adam Silvera's "More Happy Than Not" remain in Polk County Public Schools' libraries

sources.title: same article
sources.quote: It was the final book among 16 that a conservative group complained to PCPS Superintendent Frederick Heid "contained pornography" or was "harmful to children" and possibly violated Florida law.

sources.title: same article
sources.quote: Eight members of the group voted to keep it at middle and high schools, eight voted to keep it at the high school level only, while one person voted to put the book in all grade levels and one person voted to remove it from all libraries.

entry.note: Challenge outcome: book retained. Third quote supports panel split; verifier may need the 'split' wording, which is in the first quote of the article lead.

entry.text: In April 2022 the Medford School District superintendent and deputy removed the graphic novel version from the district's library collection. A report says it was removed from the school district's libraries in Dec. 2023, with the district citing graphic imagery.

sources.title: Medford superintendent, deputy approved ban of graphic novel (Mail Tribune)
sources.quote: Kevin Opsahl, Mail Tribune, Medford, Ore. Wed, June 29, 2022 at 12:21 PM UTC 5 min read

sources.title: same article
sources.quote: Jun. 29—Medford School District Superintendent Bret Champion and his deputy made the decision to remove the graphic novel version of "The Handmaid's Tale" from the district's library collection in April after a committee of officials could not come to consensus on what to do with the controversial book.

sources.title: 'The Handmaid's Tale' Was Removed from An Idaho School Library (Yahoo News)
sources.quote: The book had been removed from the school district's libraries in Dec. 2023.

sources.title: same article
sources.quote: It's administration concluded that the "graphic imagery contained within [the graphic novel adaptation of The Handmaid's Tale ] was not suitable for the West Ada School District student population," per a statement from district representative Niki Scheppers.

entry.text: The book was challenged in Wasilla, Alaska, after a boy picked it up from the juvenile non-fiction shelf of the public library, in a report dated 26 Nov 2015. In a survey reported on 19 Aug 2024, Index on Censorship said 53% of librarians polled had been asked to remove books, and This Book Is Gay by Juno Dawson was among the titles complained about.

sources.title: Parents in Alaska challenge decision to keep it on library shelves (The Guardian)
sources.quote: The book has been challenged in Wasilla, Alaska, after a 10-year-old boy picked it up from the juvenile non-fiction shelf of the public library

sources.title: same article (date line)
sources.quote: Alaska challenge decision to keep it on library shelves Alison Flood Thu 26 Nov 2015 18.06 CET

sources.title: Dozens of UK school librarians asked to remove LGBTQ+ books, survey finds (The Guardian)
sources.quote: Index on Censorship said 53% of librarians polled had been asked to remove books – and that in more than half of those cases books were taken off shelves Ella Creamer Mon 19 Aug 2024

sources.title: same article
sources.quote: Among the titles complained about were This Book Is Gay by Juno Dawson, Julián is a Mermaid by Jessica Love, and ABC Pride by Louie Stowell
